body:
"Gold Enoki mushrooms are vibrant, golden-hued fungi with a delicate flavor and a crisp texture, adding a touch of luxury to any dish."

Overview

The Golden Enoki Mushroom can be found in the same cave as Sapphire in the Snowlands. It sells for $560 raw and $1,400 in a dye jar.

It's a significantly rarer version of the Enoki Mushroom.

When this, Enoki Mushroom, and Snowdrop were first added, they all gave the same dye as Silver Brunia.

Like all other fruits and flowers, you can simply put this into a press with a jar to make it into dye, increasing the price from $560 to $1,400.
